subject: Request: Accelerated offboard exception for tenant realignment (early termination & ramp protection)
messages:
From: Daniela Ruiz <druiz@blowerhealth.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurements <procure@blowerhealth.com>, Mark Phelps <mark@blwpartner.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: early offboarding exception for regional tenant realignment

Hi Priyom —

Thanks again for the discussion this morning. Our executive team is moving forward with a strategic consolidation across our EU/US tenants; as a result we need the option to accelerate the offboarding for one BU in Q1.

Key asks from procurement:
- Ability to terminate the dedicated capacity line for the BU with 30 days notice (instead of 90).
- Downsell protection: ensure a 6-month ramp schedule that preserves reduced committed pricing rather than full re-rate to pay-as-you-go immediately.
- A one-time credit to offset migration effort (requested: USD 45k).

We understand this is non-standard. Can Redwood provide an exception path (addendum or one-off approval) that preserves a predictable cost cliff for the rest of our organization? Attaching a short statement of intent and their MOP summary.

Appreciate a quick turn — our board wants to finalize the consolidation plan by 11/15.

Best,
Daniela
Director, Strategic Procurement
Blower Health

Attachments: Blower_early_term_addendum.pdf (stub), MOP_Summary.xlsx (stub)

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniela Ruiz <druiz@blowerhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: early offboarding exception for regional tenant realignment

Thanks Daniela — I pulled this to the deal desk and looped in my manager and finance lead to evaluate. High level response and ask for internal reviewers below.

Summary of Blower request: 30-day termination window for one BU, 6-month staged ramp (preserve discounted committed price during ramp), USD 45k migration credit.

Initial assessment: we can consider a limited exception if we protect aggregate committed economics and put a clear phased downsell ladder in an addendum. Key internal questions:
- Marissa / Finance: can we preserve the committed unit pricing for up to 6 months while reducing allocation for the impacted BU, and structure a prorated credit schedule tied to usage?
- Vivek: exec signoff required on the USD 45k migration credit and any deviation from the 90-day notice.
- Legal (Karthik): will need an addendum with explicit opt-out carveouts and a clause that prevents iterative use across tenants (one-time exception).

Proposed guardrails for approval (my recommendation):
1) 30-day early term allowed for this BU only, with Redwood holding a 60% minimum revenue floor for the first 3 months post-termination for the customer across remaining tenants (protects unit economics).
2) 6-month ramp schedule: Month 1: 85% of committed pricing retained; Month 2: 70%; Month 3: 55%; Months 4–6: transition to pay-as-you-go but with a capped effective rate no worse than 20% above current committed per unit.
3) Migration credit: cap at USD 25k (counter-proposal) applied as a one-time invoice credit spread across two billing cycles.
4) Exception expires at contract anniversary; addendum includes a one-time opt-out clause and explicit non-precedent language.

Please review and advise if we should escalate to leadership for the credit delta. Daniela — if you can confirm which BU and expected timeline (target detachment date) that helps expedite.

— Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 10:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: early offboarding exception for regional tenant realignment

Priyom — good summary. A few clarifying items before we send anything to Vivek for exec sign-off: 
1) Revenue floor: 60% for first 3 months is high but defensible if we make it temporary and tied to the consolidated account run-rate. Need finance to confirm modeling.
2) Ramp ladder: I prefer simpler tiers to avoid billing complexity — propose Month 1: 80% retained, Month 2–3: 60%, Months 4–6: open with capped differential (as you suggested).
3) Credit: we shouldn't commit to USD 45k without validation. Priyom, can you request a breakdown of the 45k (migration vendors, internal ops, timeline)?
4) One-time exception: Legal must include explicit language that this exception cannot be used as precedent and requires exec approval each time.

Karthik — please review the one-time-opt-out language and advise on required wording. Laura — I need a quick revenue sensitivity table (impact to Q1 Q2) to validate the 60% floor ask.

If we can come back with a tightened proposal by EOD Monday (11/8) I can route to Vivek for a Monday evening decision.

— Marissa
Director, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 07 Nov 2026 17:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: early offboarding exception for regional tenant realignment

All — I reviewed the facts. Approve provided we put the following into the addendum and deal note: 
1) Credit approved at USD 25,000 (final). No other credits without re-submission.
2) 30-day termination is allowed for the specified BU only; addendum must identify the BU by legal entity and tenant ID.
3) Ramp protection as modified by Marissa: Month 1 = 80% retained, Months 2–3 = 60% retained, Months 4–6 = transition to PAYG with a cap of +20% effective unit rate vs current committed.
4) Include non-precedent and one-time-use clause; require Exec sign-off on any future tenant realignment exceptions.
5) Finance to model the Q1/Q2 impact and confirm revenue floor tolerances; do not apply the credit until finance signs off on billing mechanics.

Priyom — please draft the addendum and send to Karthik and Laura for legal/billing review. Once legal signs, I will countersign the addendum and instruct finance to apply the USD 25k credit per the agreed schedule.

Vivek
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
